requirement.description: Missing MemoryData.Init class and _data attribute in MemoryInstance causing AttributeError in tests

contract.description: Add MemoryData.Init class to handle memory initialization data properly. Add _data attribute to MemoryInstance to reference the memory data.

interface.output: MemoryData.Init should behave like a list-like object with proper __getitem__, __len__, and iteration support

behavior.item: MemoryData.Init should support indexing and iteration operations
MemoryInstance should have a _data attribute that references the MemoryData object
MemoryData.Init should support list-like operations for initialization data
